name: server-ledger-is-the-only-aggregate-source
why: VERIFIED P0-1. useSessionController.ts:740 appends a LiveSession to the local ledger UNCONDITIONALLY, then fires `liveSessions.create(session).catch(() => {})` — a swallowed rejection. A failed POST therefore leaves a session in the browser that the repo never receives, and the aggregate reads that store. PRD §8: 'One ledger under every view… a metric cannot drift between screens or between a screen and the write-up.' Scope note: Runs canNOT diverge — appendRun is called only from hydrateLedger.ts:131.

local_only_sessions.reason: POST rejected; append had already happened

must_exclude.reason: the cache is hydrated FROM the server, never aggregated INTO a figure

must_surface.reason: a session the server never got is a finding, not a silence — the operator must be told it exists
